referenceNotes.fr: R03 fixe le panier à gauche, l'arche à droite et la grille ; GA03 pour la peinture.
referenceNotes.en: R03 locks left hoop, right arch and fence; GA03 for paint treatment.

prompt: Render a professional film continuity reference sheet, entirely hand-painted WATERCOLOR AND OPAQUE GOUACHE on warm ivory textured paper. Use the final illustrated reference for PAINT MEDIUM ONLY: broad visible brush planes, transparent washes, dry edges, warm reserved paper, selective precise construction lines. Photographic references determine geometry and object construction. This is a convincing hand-painted artwork, not a photograph with a filter, not 3D, not glossy anime.  Exactly THREE equal vertical panels in a single landscape 16:9 sheet, with narrow clean warm-paper gutters. No captions, no letters, no labels, no people, no silhouettes, no faces in portraits, no shoes, no vehicles newer than the period. One coherent location across the panels; perspective changes must preserve architectural landmarks.  Subject: exact 1970 Bronx neighborhood basketball court. Preserve R03 photograph architecture: weathered off-white rectangular basketball backboard with red inset rectangle and rusty red rim to LEFT, continuous chain-link fence, red brick tenements with black metal fire escapes, brick arch and passage at RIGHT. Restrained gold sunset, terracotta bricks, navy shadows. LEFT: wide empty court with left hoop and right arch. CENTER: low baseline view along asphalt still seeing same hoop on left and arch on right. RIGHT: rim/net/backboard construction detail against the same period brick/fire-escape context. No players or basketball props, no skate ramps, no modern murals, no graffiti, no LED screens, no new architecture.

qa.fr: Belle lumière, mais l’arche à droite et le panier du plan bas sont hors champ : ne pas utiliser comme seul repère de géographie.
qa.en: Good light, but the right arch and low-view hoop are cropped out: do not use as the sole geography master.
